spots.title: Steep ledge
spots.why: A sharp wall beside deep water; fish hang along the edge at the depth they like.

striped.name: Striped bass
striped.bait: live bait deep at the thermocline

largemouth.name: Largemouth bass
largemouth.bait: spinnerbait or crankbait along the edge

smallmouth.name: Smallmouth bass
smallmouth.bait: tube or ned rig on rock

spots.bait: tube or ned rig on rock
